lines.t: This game had 171,000 people playing on Steam before it was even free.
AION 2 is a massive online role-playing game from the Korean studio NC.
The series is famous for one thing. Your character has wings, and you can fly.

sc.sub: the thing Aion is known for

lines.t: The first Aion launched in Korea in 2008. Back then, you could only stay in the air for 60 seconds.
This is the original, pulling in crowds at a game show.

sc.label: THE ORIGINAL AION AT A GAME SHOW

lines.t: It was huge. In China, over a million people logged in within four days.
And it had three and a half million subscribers in Asia.
Now the sequel is here. Early access opened on September 30th, with founder's packs from 25 dollars.
It peaked at 171,530 players at once on Steam.
It reportedly hit number one on Steam's top sellers in 12 countries, with over 1.3 million wishlists.
On October 5th, it goes free to play for everyone, in eight languages.
Fun fact: the first game took over two years to go free in North America. The sequel took five days.
